tests: P12: raiseEvent from plain tool-window HTML throws, and the add-in hears nothing
steps:
1. Open raiseevent-plain-html-typeerror.twinproj in the twinBASIC IDE and build it (win32). Copy Build\RaiseeventPlainHtmlTypeerror_win32.dll into %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\, restart the IDE and open any project.
2. Click the toolbar button raiseEvent repro. A tool window opens with [raise] and [direct].
3. Click [raise]. Expected: the DEBUG CONSOLE prints myEvent from raise. Actual: nothing is printed, and the IDE's page has an uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'rootEventHandler').
4. Control: click [direct]. The DEBUG CONSOLE prints myEvent from direct.
Asserted on BETA 995 and 997 by `addin-test.bat --only panes` (P12, the PanesProbe add-in in test/addin/probes/panes, of which this project is a cut-down copy).
